IF sprite_temperature_humidity_sensor_KD30.get_temperature() > 19 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_on_natural_fan() mijia_natural_fan

IF mijia_CO2_ultra_sensor.get_CO2_concentration() > 5 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_on() mijia_air_purifier_MAX
